liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Described as incredible, alongside the performance of Eyes of the World [18]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Described as a treat, while the new Weather Report Suite was excellent [13]
- **Let Me Sing Your Blues Away** (1 review): A lousy song sung and played poorly, yet striking as a group effort [16]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Smooth and tasty performance redeeming the previous song's flaws [16]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Reviewer claims this is their favorite performance of the song [17]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Beautiful performance with incredibly articulate playing from Jerry Garcia [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-09-08.mtx.tobin.126079.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 29 songs; 211 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd73-09-08.sbd.wulf.183.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 189 min; rated 4.52/5 by 31 [7]. Said about its sound: Tight groove with simmering tension, though tempo was slightly slow; Sounds very nice, fitting fans who love the 1973 era [10][14]
- **gd1973-09-08.sbd.goodbear.78349.flac16**: soundboard; 29 songs; 193 min; rated 3.62/5 by 8 [8]
- **gd1973-09-08.upg-sbd.tobin.126071.flac16**: soundboard; 29 songs; 211 min [2]

## Around the show

- Security was nasty the previous night, making the crowd jumpy [13]
- Tense atmosphere from prior drug busts, replaced by solid band groove [15]
- A huge Skull and Roses banner towered above the band [15]
- Show marked Pigpen's first birthday after his death the previous spring [20]
- Energy level matches other 1973 shows despite an ordinary setlist [9]
- Complete Weather Report Suite included, though the Sept 11 version is better [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-09-08.mtx.tobin.126079.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid=183) SBD> master reel> cassette> Dat >HD> shn; transfer by T. Wul + AUD (shn id 126070) source: aud cassette master; taped by… [1]. Also: Mixed by archive.org user, converted to FLAC in November 2013 [1]
- **gd73-09-08.sbd.wulf.183.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [7]
- **gd1973-09-08.sbd.goodbear.78349.flac16**: transferred by Goodbear; source: Sbd, Reel M->Cass 1->Dat 0->DAT 1->CD->FLAC, [8]. Also: Reel to Cass1 to DAT1, edited May 1999, then CD and FLAC [8]
- **gd1973-09-08.upg-sbd.tobin.126071.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD> master reel> cassette> Dat >HD> shn; transfer by T. Wulf:(original shn 183) - pitch correction and patches by Kevin Tobin [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_36.html) [22]
